name: Skins for YouTube player
description:
Skins for YouTube player gives your YouTube player a personalized look and adds the controls YouTube forgot. Every feature is a simple toggle, and each one works independently.

SKINS
- Hundreds of player skins: choose one at youtube-skins.com, click "Add," and it appears in the extension menu right on the player.
- All icons are vector, so every skin stays crisp at any screen size or resolution.
- The collection keeps growing, and your favorites and recently added skins are always just one click away.

PICTURE AND PLAYER
- Dark theme: YouTube’s own dark mode on every page, always on, without having to use the Appearance menu.
- True black: pure black backgrounds instead of YouTube’s dark gray, perfect for OLED screens and late-night viewing.
- Always HD: every video starts at the highest quality available.
- Cinema mode: the area around the player dims after a few seconds of inactivity, and lights back up as soon as you move your mouse.
- Progress bar: always keep the timeline visible, no more waiting for it to show up.

SOUND
- Optimize volume: YouTube quietly lowers the volume on loud videos. With this on, the volume you set is the volume you get, and 100% really means 100%.

ADS
- Autoskip ads: the Skip button is clicked for you the moment it appears.

TOOLS ON THE PLAYER
- Screenshot: save the current frame as a PNG image.
- Transcript: read the video’s text, copy it, or download it as TXT, SRT, or VTT.
- Thumbnail: download the video’s cover image in HD.

The extension only runs on YouTube and youtube-skins.com, and skins are loaded from our own CDN. Check the site often for new skins, and please rate the extension if it makes your YouTube experience better.
